blocks.prompt: 11. If Salman starts with Rs. 5,000 and saves Rs. 1,000 monthly, derive \(S(n)\) and prove it by induction.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal ke do hisse hain: pehle \(S(n)\), yani \(n\) mahine baad kul bachat, ka formula khud nikalna (derive karna), phir usay induction se saabit karna.
Salman ke paas shuru mein Rs. 5,000 hain aur woh har mahine ke aakhir mein Rs. 1,000 jama karta hai.
Plan: chhoti si table, pattern \(S(n) = 5000 + 1000n\), mahana rule \(S(k + 1) = S(k) + 1000\), aur phir induction.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: shuru ki raqam Rs. 5,000; har mahine Rs. 1,000 ki bachat.
Maloom karna hai: \(S(n)\), \(n\) mahine baad kul bachat, aur us ka induction se saboot.
Tareeqa: Pehle chand mahinon se pattern pehchanein, phir mathematical induction.

Table bana kar pattern pehchanein
\[S(1) = 6000,\ S(2) = 7000,\ S(3) = 8000\]
\[S(n) = 5000 + 1000n\]
Kyun: \(n\) mahinon mein woh Rs. 1,000 theek \(n\) dafa jama karta hai, yani \(1000n\), aur yeh shuru ke Rs. 5,000 mein jurta hai. Har mahine raqam 1000 barhti hai, is liye yeh A.P. jaisa pattern hai.

Statement aur mahana rule
\[P(n): S(n) = 5000 + 1000n\]
\[S(k + 1) = S(k) + 1000\]
Kyun: Har mahina Rs. 1,000 jor deta hai. Statement ko \(P(n)\) ka naam diya, kyunke \(S(n)\) pehle se bachat ka naam hai; ek naam do cheezon ke liye rakhne se confusion hoti hai.

Base case: \(n = 1\)
\[S(1) = 5000 + 1000 = 6000\]
\[5000 + 1000(1) = 6000\]
Is liye \(P(1)\) sahi hai.
Kyun: Ek mahine baad us ke paas Rs. 5,000 aur ek bachat Rs. 1,000, kul Rs. 6,000; formula bhi wahi deta hai.

Induction hypothesis: \(P(k)\) ko sahi maan lein
\[S(k) = 5000 + 1000k \quad (A)\]
Kyun: Farz kiya ke \(k\) mahine baad formula sahi bachat deta hai.

Inductive step: pehle rule, phir (A)
\[S(k + 1) = S(k) + 1000\]
\[= 5000 + 1000k + 1000\]
\[= 5000 + 1000(k + 1)\]
Is liye \(P(k + 1)\) sahi hai.
Kyun: Rule mein \(S(k)\) ki jagah (A) rakha. Phir \(1000k + 1000\) mein 1000 common nikala: \(1000(k + 1)\). Yeh bilkul \(n = k + 1\) wala formula hai.
Dhyan dein: Kuch students \(S(n) = 5000 + 1000(n - 1)\) likh dete hain; yeh tab sahi hota jab pehle mahine koi bachat na hoti. Sawal ke mutabiq pehle mahine ke aakhir mein bhi 1000 jama hota hai.

Conclusion
\(P(1)\) sahi hai aur \(P(k)\) se \(P(k + 1)\) sahi hota hai. Principle of mathematical induction se \(S(n) = 5000 + 1000n\) har positive integer \(n\) ke liye sahi hai.
Kyun: Induction ki dono sharten poori ho gayin.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 12\) (ek saal)
\[S(12) = 5000 + 12{,}000 = 17{,}000\]
Kyun: Saal bhar mein 12 dafa Rs. 1,000 jama hue, shuru ke Rs. 5,000 ke saath kul Rs. 17,000. Aap khud bhi gin kar dekh sakte hain.
blocks.final_answer: \(S(n) = 5000 + 1000n\) rupees, \(n\) mahine baad; induction se saabit ho gaya.
